mesures.name: Les mesures · Measures and Quantities
mesures.alt: A practical measurement class weighs a delivery and checks fabric, length, mass and liquid volume. balance scale with a block of butter and a mass marked 500 g; long scarf measured against a straight ruler marked 1 m; dressmaker mannequin with a long tie around its waist; key-backed snail beside a route card marked 1 km; tailor measuring a fabric roll with a tape; large iron weight hanging from a spring balance on a stand; small patient donkey harnessed to a cart of sacks; large brass key on a low scale whose display reads 1 kg; clear graduated measuring jug filled exactly to the 1 L line. Ground-floor measurement laboratory in the mathematics institute, entered from the campus path.

calcul.name: Le laboratoire du calcul · Calculation Workshop
calcul.alt: A tutor and learners prepare three activity kits while a red-beret mime triples two blocks into six. left slate showing exactly 2 + 3 = 5 beside two and three counting beads. two stages: stacks of two and four blocks become three and three; twelve blocks painted across both stages. adult woman solving arithmetic on a floor mat at left. left board with exactly two rows of three counters and the equation 2 × 3 = 6. large numeral 8 and exactly eight wooden counters on a right board. ticket dispenser with one paper ticket marked 12 on the right. adult male mime with white face striped shirt and bright red beret arranging three identical trays each with two blocks in the center foreground

geometrie.name: Les formes et les repères · Shapes and Reference Points
geometrie.alt: Adult learners build a triangular model and check its angle, formula, interval and reference-book rating. left blackboard showing A = b × h / 2 with triangle diagram. left model work area ending at a clear red boundary line. an assessment clipboard showing 4/5 with four filled stars and one empty star. a large tick-marked semicircular protractor measuring a wooden triangle corner. right board showing 3 × 4 = 12 with three groups of four counters. right ruler-like number line from 0 to 4 with equal gaps between adjacent marks
